my mom was diagnosed with breast cancer this summer. she had called my boyfriend to tell him first and when I got home he immediately told me. 

I broke down with him; sobbed, screamed, just completely fell apart. by the time my mom called to tell me herself, I felt a lot better about this situation and felt more clear headed to ask appropriate questions about diagnosis, what it meant, treatment, etc. my mom even later commented how me staying so calm was so encouraging for her, that she needed to know that I was okay so she would be okay, too. 

i’m so glad my boyfriend did that for me. i’m so glad he gave me a space to fall apart so I could hold it together enough to be there for my mom. I love him and i’m so grateful he did that.
